title: Peumeurintahan Geu-uji Le Saboh Krueng .
intro: Sidroe peumimpén geubeudôh deungon keuputosan ilahi bak masa jameun. Peumeurintahan peunguasa nyoe hana geumulai deungon keumuliaan tapi deungon ujian le ie nyang ji-ile. Musoh yang teuga akan menantang teuntra awak nyan, dan hasee jih akan membentuk ulang jalan seujarah. Jeut neukira soe tokoh nyoe?
clues: Ulôn ka teupiléh keu lôn pimpén saboh bansa nyang raya, teuma peulantikan nyan teuka nibak ateueh, kon nibak rakyat.
Saboh beunda suci geubri pulang ubak umat ulôn sibagoe tanda nyang teupeukong peumeurintahan ulôn.
Lon uji teuntra lon ngon krueng — paleng le jiep ie krueng nyan dan gagal.
Sidroë pahlawan njang that teuga njang nan djih Jalut djidjak prang kamoë deungon teuntra njang rajek that.
Sidroë aneuk muda nibak barisan ulôn keudroë, njang hana meusenjata sapeuë keutjuali iman, djipoh Jalut.
Lheuëh meunang geutanjoë, keuradjeuën njan akhédjih djipeu-atô keu juara muda njan.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Geu rhom lam apui nyang meuhu-hu .

location.label: Unsur Kunci
options: Saboh sling ngon batée-batée nyang gleh .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Ditarek deungon aman nibak apui nyang teungoh meu-ulang-ulang .
Ditutong udep-udep lam parit nyang meuapui-apui .

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
